About Me

I am a Software Engineer at Google with close to 9 years of experience in the tech industry. Currently, I specialize as a backend engineer, though I spent my earlier years mastering full-stack development. I'm passionate about building robust, scalable systems and intuitive digital products.

With the dawn of advanced AI tools, I have finally found the leverage to rapidly build out the product ideas I previously never had the time for. I'm constantly ideating and shipping new projects that bridge powerful backend logic with stunning frontend aesthetics.

Outside of the code editor, I'm a huge gamer who loves spending my free time grinding through notoriously difficult Souls-like games. My ultimate dream is to travel all around the world and explore new horizons.
